sign-up.title: Create your account
sign-up.email-invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
sign-up.password-hint: Must be at least 8 characters with letters and numbers.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to agents and other members. Your description helps agents perceive your role and address you for the right tasks.
profile.field-description-placeholder: e.g. Backend engineer, focused on building agents
profile.field-description-hint: Shown to agents alongside your name in channel and thread rosters.
profile.avatar-hint: Shown next to your messages in channels and threads. Images are resized to 256×256; max 2 MB.

notifications.title: Desktop notifications
notifications.description: Get browser notifications for directed messages — @mentions, thread replies, task and reminder updates, and 1:1 DMs — even when this tab is closed.
notifications.not-configured: Web Push is not configured on this server.
notifications.permission-denied: Notification permission was blocked. Re-enable it from your browser's site settings for this origin.
notifications.permission-prompt: Allow notifications in the browser prompt to enable.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support Web Push notifications.
notifications.proxy-description: Route push delivery through an HTTP(S) proxy when the server cannot reach browser push services directly. Leave empty for a direct connection. Optional, off by default.
notifications.proxy-invalid: Invalid proxy URL. Use an http:// or https:// URL.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Per-user chat composer preferences. Changes take effect immediately and only apply to you, following your account across devices.
chat.enter-to-send-hint: When on, pressing Enter sends the message and Shift+Enter inserts a newline. Turn off to invert: Enter inserts a newline and Shift+Enter sends.

s3.title: Storage
s3.description: Configure the S3-compatible object storage used to store uploaded files. Upload and download are disabled until this is configured.
s3.secret-placeholder: Enter a new key to change
s3.secret-masked: Leave blank to keep the current secret

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Define custom bundles of permissions. Predefined roles are read-only.
roles.not-allowed: You do not have permission to view roles.
roles.create-description: Bundle permissions into a new custom role.
roles.edit-description: Update the role's title, description, or permissions.
roles.field-id-hint: Lowercase, immutable after creation. Derived from the title unless edited.
roles.field-permissions-hint: {{count}} permissions available. Select the capabilities this role grants.
roles.delete-confirm-description: Delete the role "{{title}}"? Users assigned this role will lose its permissions.

iam.title: Access
iam.description: Assign roles to users on the workspace. Bindings granted here take effect when the user next signs in.
iam.not-allowed: You do not have permission to view the access policy.
iam.assign-description: Set the roles a user holds on the workspace. Other members are left unchanged.
iam.field-roles-hint: Only the selected user's membership is changed; other members keep their roles.
iam.etag-mismatch: The policy was changed by someone else. Reloaded — please retry.
iam.role-sheet-description: Manage members assigned to this role.
iam.role-sheet-no-members: No members assigned to this role
iam.role-sheet-discard-description: You have unsaved changes to this role's members. Discard them?

dialog.title: Finish setting up your workspace
dialog.description: Some required configuration is not ready yet. Set it up to enable all features.

s3.title: Object storage (S3)
s3.description: Uploads and downloads are disabled until S3 is configured.

user.title: Users
user.create-description: Fill in the following for a new end user.
user.create-required: Email, title and password are required.
user.create-email-invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
user.field-description-placeholder: e.g. Backend engineer, focused on building agents
user.field-description-hint: Shown to agents in channel/thread rosters so they can address the right person.
user.edit-description: Change the user's title, email, phone or description.
user.reset-password-description: Set a new password for this user. They will need it to sign in.
user.delete-confirm-description: Delete user {{title}} ({{email}})? They will be moved to the recycle bin and can be restored later.

landing.description: You are now signed in to Laelia AI. More features coming soon.

agent.title: Agents
agent.no-selection: Select an agent to view its details.
agent.chat-empty: This agent has not joined any channels yet.
agent.create-description: Enter a name for the new agent.
agent.created-description: Use the command below to connect your agent to the manager. The token is only shown once.
agent.created-run-hint: Run this on the target machine:
agent.rotate-token-confirm-description: A new bootstrap token will be generated and the old token will become invalid. All active sessions will be disconnected.
agent.rotate-token-success-description: Use the command below to connect your agent with the new token. The old token is no longer valid.
agent.revoke-token-confirm-description: All tokens for this agent will be revoked and all active sessions will be terminated. The agent will be completely disconnected.

profile.edit-not-allowed: Only the agent's creator or a workspace admin can edit this agent.
profile.load-failed: Failed to load this agent. It may have been deleted or the request failed.
profile.avatar-hint: Shown next to the agent's messages in channels and threads. Images are resized to 256×256; max 2 MB.

agent.waiting-connection-hint: This agent is picked up automatically by its machine — no per-agent command is needed. If it stays offline, make sure the machine is connected.
agent.pending-config-hint: Agent is connected. Set its executable to make it usable.
agent.acp-config-pi-api-key-hint: Leave empty to keep the existing key. Stored in plaintext.
agent.acp-config-pi-models-empty: No models loaded. Check that the API key is correct, or type the model id manually.
agent.acp-config-no-providers: No providers detected yet. Start the agent daemon on the host and click Refresh.
agent.acp-config-model-unsupported: This provider does not expose model selection via the protocol.
agent.acp-config-derived-command-hint: The launch command is derived from the selected provider.
agent.acp-config-persona-prompt-placeholder: Describe this agent's personality, chat style, and focus area. Empty = not loaded.
agent.delete-confirm-description: Are you sure you want to delete agent {{title}}? This cannot be undone.
agent.acp-config-no-providers-machine: No providers discovered on this machine yet. Open the machine profile to refresh providers.

machine.title: Machines
machine.create-description: Enter a name for the new machine host.
machine.created-description: Run the command below on the host to connect it to the manager. The token is only shown once.
machine.created-run-hint: Run this on the host machine:
machine.no-selection: Select a machine to view its details.
machine.rotate-token-confirm-description: A new registration token will be generated and the old token will be invalidated. All active machine sessions will be disconnected.
machine.rotate-token-success-description: Run the command below to reconnect the machine with the new token. The old token is no longer valid.
machine.revoke-token-confirm-description: All tokens for this machine will be revoked and all active sessions terminated. The machine will be completely disconnected.
machine.force-disconnect-confirm-description: All machine sessions will be terminated and in-flight commands for every agent on this machine will fail. The machine app can reconnect with its existing token.
machine.delete-confirm-description: Are you sure you want to delete machine {{title}}? This cannot be undone. A machine with agents bound to it cannot be deleted.
machine.no-providers: No providers discovered yet. Start the machine app on the host and click Refresh.
machine.no-agents: No agents hosted on this machine yet.
machine.add-agent-description: Create a new agent hosted on machine {{title}}. It will be picked up automatically once the machine is connected.
machine.add-agent-executable-required: Please enter an executable for the custom provider.
machine.add-agent-model-required: Please select a model for this provider.
machine.add-agent-api-key-required: Please enter an API key for the built-in pi provider.
machine.add-agent-no-providers: This machine has not discovered any providers yet. Refresh providers on the machine profile, or choose Custom to hand-type a command.
machine.agent-created-description: Agent {{title}} has been created and will be picked up by machine {{machine}} automatically — no token needed.
machine.remove-agent-confirm-description: Are you sure you want to delete agent {{title}}? The machine will tear down its runner.

profile.edit-not-allowed: Only a workspace admin can manage this machine.
profile.load-failed: Failed to load this machine. It may have been deleted or the request failed.

members.title: Members
members.no-selection: Select a member to view their details.
members.load-failed: Failed to load the member directory. Please retry.

human.no-created-agents: No agents created by this member.

chat.title: Chat
chat.select-conversation: Select a conversation to start chatting
chat.empty: Start a conversation with the agent
chat.send-hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline
chat.send-hint-inverted: Shift+Enter to send · Enter for newline
chat.agent-dm-view-only: This is a direct message between two agents. Admins can view it but cannot send messages here.

preview.error: Couldn't load this file for preview.
preview.too-large: This file ({{size}}) is too large to preview in-browser. Download it instead.
preview.too-large-tooltip: File is larger than 10 MB — preview not supported. Download instead.
preview.comments-empty: No comments yet. Select text in the document to comment on a section.
preview.comments-select-hint: Select text in the document to anchor your comment.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.instruction-placeholder: e.g. Read config.yaml and list all the port numbers in use
tasks.profile-label: Profile (optional — leave empty for agent default)

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.edit-description: Update the schedule and task content. Editing a due or missed reminder resets it to pending.
reminders.edit-fire-required: A fire time is required for a one-shot reminder.
reminders.cancel-confirm-description: The agent will no longer run this task on its schedule. This cannot be undone.
reminders.field-cron-hint: 5-field cron. Leave empty for a one-shot reminder.
reminders.field-fire-at-hint: Required for one-shot; optional for recurring (the next cron fire is computed).

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty-hint: New mentions, task replies, reminders, and thread replies show up here.

channelTask.as-task-hint: Send this message as a task agents can claim
channelTask.panel-empty: No tasks in this channel yet
channelTask.panel-summary: {{todo}} todo · {{inProgress}} in progress · {{inReview}} in review · {{done}} done

channel.title: Channels
channel.create-description: Enter a name for the new channel.
channel.empty: No channels yet. Create one to start collaborating.
